gloss: serving plate; large plate for arranging food

definitions.gloss: serving plate; large plate for arranging food
definitions.explanation: A plate, often larger and shallower than an individual dish, used to display or serve food that has been arranged on it — sashimi, fruit, sweets, side dishes, or hors d'oeuvres. Found in Japanese restaurants, izakaya, home dining, and as a sales unit ('plate of X') in food shops.

examples.japanese: {盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: To arrange fruit on a serving plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{綺麗|きれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: Sashimi is beautifully arranged on a large serving plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Izakaya serving plates are convenient for sharing among several people.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ ('to heap; to arrange (food on a plate)') and ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧ ('plate'); the second element undergoes rendaku, becoming ざら. Refers specifically to a plate used to display or serve arranged food, often larger than an individual dish.

USAGE:
- Common in restaurant menus and price lists, e.g., ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら} ('sashimi serving plate') or ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら} ('fruit platter').
- May refer to either the plate itself or the food arranged on it (e.g., 'a plate of sashimi').
- The verb ⟦{盛|も}る→盛る：00292_moru⟧ ('to heap up; to arrange on a plate') is at the heart of Japanese ⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧ ('food presentation'), which {盛|も}り{皿|ざら} supports.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange on a serving plate
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら}: a large serving plate
- ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{盛|も}り{皿|ざら}: a sashimi serving plate
- {盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: dishes served on a serving plate
- {盛|も}り{皿|ざら}⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧: one serving plate (often a price unit)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{大皿|おおざら}→大皿：04477_oozara⟧: large plate — close synonym; emphasizes size of the plate rather than the act of arranging food.
- ⟦{取|と}り{皿|ざら}→取り皿：17051_torizara⟧: small plate for taking individual portions from a shared dish — counterpart used by each diner.
- ⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧: assortment; combination plate — refers to a mixed selection of food (often on a single plate), e.g., ⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{盛|も}り{合|あ}わせ→盛り合わせ：21762_moriawase⟧.
- ⟦プレート→プレート：11704_pureeto⟧: plate (loanword) — used in Western-style menu language, often for single-serve plates.
- ⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧: plate — the general word for any plate.
